s: The Lord comes to judge Samaria and Jerusalem.
Woe to those who plot evil and seize fields. God will gather a remnant.
Micah condemns corrupt leaders, priests and prophets.
In the last days the nations will come to the Lord's mountain, and swords will be beaten into ploughshares.
From Bethlehem will come forth a ruler of Israel, whose origin is from of old.
What does the Lord require of you: to do justice, love mercy and walk humbly with your God.
Micah waits for the God of his salvation, who will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.

5: Micah foretells that Israel's ruler will come from little Bethlehem. The wise men are told this when they look for the newborn king.
